# Bounce — account brief

## Who
Bounce operates a network of luggage storage locations in cities around the world ([usebounce.com](https://usebounce.com/)). Its GitHub org is usebounce ([github.com](https://github.com/usebounce)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json in usebounce/bounce-app ([github.com](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- react-native 0.74.5 in usebounce/bounce-app/package.json ([github.com](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json))
- CI workflows in usebounce/bounce-app ([github.com](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- usebounce/bounce-app last pushed 2026-08-18 ([github.com](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app))
- 14 public repos and 96 followers on github.com/usebounce ([github.com](https://github.com/usebounce))
- 12,800 App Store ratings ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349))
- 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349))

## Why now
The app repo was pushed two days ago ([github.com](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app)). Bounce shipped 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days and runs react-native 0.74.5 ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)) ([github.com](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
You are shipping to the App Store roughly every three weeks, with 5 releases in the last 90 days ([apps.apple.com](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bounce-luggage-storage/id1531544349)). Your repo has eas.json and GitHub Actions workflows side by side ([github.com](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/blob/main/eas.json)) ([github.com](https://github.com/usebounce/bounce-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)). At that cadence, are store builds and OTA updates fully automated from CI, or does someone still kick off EAS builds by hand?
